descriptionChirho: To bring, fetch, or convey someone or something toward the speaker or a specified destination.
To carry, bear, or transport a physical object or person from one place to another.
To bear fruit, yield produce, or bring forth results, used of plants or metaphorically of persons.
To bear with, endure, or tolerate something difficult or burdensome.
To be driven, carried along, or led by an external force such as wind, the Spirit, or circumstances.
